title: docs(adr-0090): D5 — removing a row one owns is not a delete bit (#33010 ruling)
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DU5CHkeh2msc49m4dh6kwEt)_

## Summary

Docs-only companion to #33322 (merged). The maintainer's ruling on #33010 (comment 6879388034) says a member may delete an attachment they uploaded themselves, own uploads only, and that the ADR-0090 D5 text saying the member grant has no delete bit gets a matching sentence. This records that sentence as a dated note in D5, after the `Note (2026-10-14)` blockquote, citing the ruling by its record id: removing a row one owns is served by an own-row delete door, not by `allowDelete` on a set bound to `everyone`; the attachment member grant stays read and create only.

## What changes

- `docs/adr/0090-permission-model-v2-concept-convergence.md`: one new dated note blockquote in D5, `Note (2026-11-14, ruling of record 6879388034 on #33010)`, after the `Note (2026-10-14)` blockquote. No ruled text is edited.
- Review 2, item 1, option (a): the first head placed the sentence as a D5 bullet directly above the `Revision (2026-09-12, #17189)` blockquote, whose ruled text opens with "the bullet above" and means the D7 lint bullet. As a dated note after the last D5 blockquote it no longer sits between that revision and its antecedent.

## Landing

Governed surface (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H): lands only on its tier's record. #33322 merged 2026-11-14T21:19Z, so the door the note names is on `main`.

No code, no changeset.
